nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) public balances; stores token balances and is mutated by transfer/transferFrom
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance; spender approvals written in approve and read in transferFrom
IEP20 eventer; external contract handle set in constructor and called from transfer/transferFrom
uint256 public totalSupply = 1 * 10**12 * 10**18; minted to deployer in constructor
string public name = "Baby Dragon"; token metadata
string public symbol; token metadata stored as hex string
uint public decimals = 18; token metadata
constructor(IEP20 _consparam) sets eventer and mints totalSupply to msg.sender
balanceOf(address wallet) public view returns balances[wallet]
dgst(address acct) public pure returns abi.encodePacked(acct), used for ripemd160 hashing before the external wevent check
transfer(address to, uint256 value) public; performs external wevent check then unchecked balance updates
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) public; external wevent check, allowance check and unchecked balance updates
approve(address holder, uint256 value) public; writes allowance[msg.sender][holder] with no zero-address or event checks
msg.sender; used for balance accounting, approval owner and transfer sender
balances[to] += value in transfer; unchecked arithmetic on attacker-controlled value
balances[msg.sender] -= value in transfer; unchecked subtraction guarded only by a require balance check
balances[to] += value in transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic
balances[from] -= value in transferFrom; unchecked subtraction guarded by require balance and allowance checks
allowance[msg.sender][holder] = value in approve; unconditional state write with no AccessControl or event
external call eventer.wevent(ripemd160(dgst(...))) to an arbitrary IEP20 contract supplied at construction; reentrancy / DoS surface
address to parameter of transfer, destination of the credited balance
uint256 value parameter of transfer, amount added and subtracted from balances
address from parameter of transferFrom, debited account
address to parameter of transferFrom, credited account
uint256 value parameter of transferFrom, amount moved
address holder parameter of approve, spender granted the allowance
uint256 value parameter of approve, allowance amount written to state
address wallet parameter of balanceOf, lookup key for the balances mapping
address acct parameter of dgst, address encoded and hashed before the external call
IEP20 _consparam constructor parameter assigned to the eventer state variable

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the balances key in the constructor mint and in transfer/transferFrom accounting
constructor parameter _consparam is stored into the eventer state variable
_consparam is consumed by the constructor
constructor writes the eventer external contract reference
constructor initializes balances[msg.sender] with totalSupply
transfer parameter to is used as destination index of balances
transfer parameter value flows into the balance updates
transferFrom parameter from is the debited account and allowance owner
transferFrom parameter to is the credited account
transferFrom parameter value flows into balance and allowance checks
approve parameter holder becomes the spender key in allowance
approve parameter value is written into the allowance mapping
balanceOf parameter wallet indexes the balances mapping
dgst parameter acct is abi.encodePacked into the returned hash input
user-supplied value is added to balances[to] without overflow protection (Solidity 0.7.x)
user-supplied value is subtracted from balances[msg.sender] without underflow protection
user-supplied value is added to balances[to] in transferFrom without overflow protection
user-supplied value is subtracted from balances[from] in transferFrom without underflow protection
approve value is written directly into allowance for msg.sender
msg.sender owns the balance that transfer decrements
transfer invokes the external eventer.wevent check before mutating balances
transferFrom invokes the external eventer.wevent check before mutating balances
transfer executes the unchecked credit to balances[to]
transfer executes the unchecked debit from balances[msg.sender]
transferFrom executes the unchecked credit to balances[to]
transferFrom executes the unchecked debit from balances[from]
approve executes the unconditional allowance write
transfer calls balanceOf to verify sufficient balance
transferFrom calls balanceOf to verify sufficient balance
transfer calls dgst to build the ripemd160 input for the external check
transferFrom calls dgst to build the ripemd160 input for the external check
transferFrom reads allowance[from][msg.sender] before moving tokens
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][holder]
attacker-controlled eventer contract can re-enter transfer during the external wevent call
attacker-controlled eventer contract can re-enter transferFrom during the external wevent call

parameter value is consumed only by the transfer balance updates
parameter from is only used within transferFrom as allowance owner and debit key
parameter to is only used within transferFrom as credit key
parameter value is consumed only by transferFrom balance/allowance logic
parameter holder is only used as the allowance spender key inside approve
parameter value is only written to allowance inside approve

parameter acct is only encoded inside the dgst hash helper
